insight: Predict pro player decisions before watching them execute, then pause and analyze why they diverged from your prediction. This forces you to understand reasoning rather than passively watching.

insight: Buy Quelling Blade over early Helm of the Dominator when you have defensive tools available (Oracle heals, allies with disarm). This delays Helm but allows you to maximize stat efficiency early.
